newsitem.title: THAILAND: HongkongBank Thailand cuts minimum lending rate.
newsitem.headline: HongkongBank Thailand cuts minimum lending rate.

text.p: The Bangkok branch of Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corp Ltd (HongkongBank) said on Wednesday it had cut its minimum lending rate (MLR) to 13.25 percent from 13.50 with immediate effect.
"The move brings HongkongBank's MLR in line with Thailand's leading local banks and puts it ahead of its foreign bank competitors," the bank said in a statement.
"This move is in line with the Bank of Thailand's wishes to see a reduction in interest rates to stimulate the economy," the bank's chief executive officer Richard Cromwell said.
"Despite recent signs of a lack in investor confidence, as Thailand's first bank (commercial bank to be established), we remain absolutely committed to this market," he added.
The bank recently applied to the finance ministry to allow it to set up two more full branches, he said.
